_comment: Bitso (Bugcrowd) example. Copy to igor.config.json, fill tokens. Read every note.
_scope_note: ONLY the in-scope hosts from the brief. Do not add subdomains; api-sandbox, stage, dev etc. are explicitly OUT of scope. Mobile apps can't be tested by IGOR.
_delay_note: Be gentle on a financial target. The brief discourages DDoS/brute-force. 1-2s between requests. Do NOT set this low.
_global_note: MANDATORY. The brief says traffic without this header can get you IP-banned and treated as a real attack. It rides on every request IGOR sends, including the unauthenticated baseline. Replace YOUR_USERNAME with your Bugcrowd handle.
_sessions_note: Register both accounts with your @bugcrowdninja.com email (auto-approved per the brief). Real auth may use cookies or custom headers instead of a Bearer token; capture a real request in Burp to see what this target actually uses, and mirror it here.
_safety: Read-side only to start (igor run). Do NOT point writetest at financial flows (balances/trades/transfers). Avoid enum on this target; sequential-ID walking looks like brute-forcing.
